bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 20.5K on YouTube. Your mentorship is a £799 buy button.
beats.text: “Learn to trade with Jason Sen as your personal mentor & performance coach” sits on your pricing page between £79 signals and a £93 course, with a “Buy Now” button. Someone about to spend £799 on a mentor usually wants to speak to him first.

beats.title: 3,317 people on your free Telegram.
beats.text: Your channel has 2.59M views, and you posted 15 videos in the last two weeks alone. Your signal subscribers watch you trade every day. The ones who want to learn your method instead of copying it are your mentorship clients.

beats.title: Eight products on one pricing page.
beats.text: A free course, three signal plans, three paid courses and the mentorship, all side by side. A visitor has to work out alone which one fits, and the most valuable one asks for £799 without a single conversation.

beats.title: “My signals are the business.” They stay.
beats.text: Signals keep running at £79 to £174 a month and keep bringing people in. The mentorship gets its own page, a short application and a call, so the traders who want your three-step method talk to you before they pay.
beats.quote: “With 40 years of trading experience from the Stock Exchange & LIFFE floors to digital trading, I provide battle-tested technical analysis and personalised mentoring that transforms struggling traders into consistent performers”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: Your chart reading isn't consistent
cards.body: Some days the levels make sense. Most days you're guessing where to enter.

cards.title: Your risk changes with your mood
cards.body: Stops moved, size doubled after a loss, no rules for the account as a whole.

cards.title: You sabotage your own trades
cards.body: You know what to do. In the moment, fear or impatience decides instead.

mechanism.title: Three steps, forty years of practice
mechanism.body: Jason's method comes from the trading floor: simple but effective technical analysis, strict trade, risk and account management, and the psychology to follow both. In the mentorship, he works through all three with you, tailored to your experience level and learning style.

pillars.title: Technical analysis
pillars.body: Simple, effective chart reading across multiple time frames.

pillars.title: Trade management

pillars.title: Risk & account
pillars.body: Rules that protect the account, not just the trade.

pillars.title: Psychology

questions.q: How long have you been trading?

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades ready, wins and losses, and note what you trade.

One note: payments only happen through the official Day Trade Ideas website or from this email address, never through a DM.

Speak soon,
Jason

preCallEmails.subject: What the trading floor taught me
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I started on the LIFFE floor at 19. Forty years later, the traders who last all do three things: they read the chart simply, they manage every trade and the whole account with strict rules, and they work on their psychology as hard as their entries.

That's the three-step method we'll go through together.

On the call we'll look at which of the three is holding you back today.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have the signals"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then you've seen how I trade
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Good. Then you've seen my analysis every day.

The mentorship is for when copying isn't the goal anymore: we work on your own analysis, your risk rules and your psychology, so you can make the decisions yourself.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. I'll tell you honestly.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the mentorship works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, I'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Jason
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Jason

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Speak soon,
Jason
